A first stop before [Classic Drum Machines Compared](drum-compare.qmd). Short sections, one idea each. Click a heading to fold or open it.

::: {.ik-do}
**What you'll do**

1. Read what the TR-909 is and when it was made.
2. Learn its sound, one idea at a time.
3. Take a guided tour: press each **▶ Hear step** button and listen for one change.
4. Find records it is on.
5. Check yourself with a short quiz.
:::

## What it is

- The **TR-909** was made by **Roland** and came out in **1983** (Wikipedia, "Roland TR-909").
- Its drums are circuits like the 808's, but its **hi-hats and cymbals are samples** (Wikipedia).
- Wikipedia: "the 909, alongside the TB-303 synthesizer, influenced dance music such as techno, house and acid."

## Its sound

- The **bass drum** has **Attack** and **Decay** knobs (TR-909 manual, p. 8).
- **Accent** can be set per drum, plus a total accent (manual, p. 25).
- **Shuffle** has 7 settings that swing the beat; **flam** plays a drum twice, close together (manual, p. 26).
- It has **MIDI** (manual, p. 5).

## Guided tour

Each step plays two bars. One thing is added or changed each time.

```{=html}
<div class="ik-step" data-pat="{&quot;bpm&quot;:124,&quot;rows&quot;:{&quot;kick&quot;:&quot;x...x...x...x...&quot;},&quot;kit&quot;:{&quot;kick&quot;:{&quot;attack&quot;:2,&quot;decay&quot;:5}}}"><p><b>Four on the floor.</b> Bass drum on every beat, <b>Attack</b> low. Listen: round.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-pat="{&quot;bpm&quot;:124,&quot;rows&quot;:{&quot;kick&quot;:&quot;x...x...x...x...&quot;},&quot;kit&quot;:{&quot;kick&quot;:{&quot;attack&quot;:9,&quot;decay&quot;:5}}}"><p><b>Attack up.</b> Attack at 9. Listen: a sharper click on each kick.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-pat="{&quot;bpm&quot;:124,&quot;rows&quot;:{&quot;kick&quot;:&quot;x...x...x...x...&quot;,&quot;clap&quot;:&quot;....x.......x...&quot;,&quot;ohh&quot;:&quot;..x...x...x...x.&quot;},&quot;kit&quot;:{&quot;kick&quot;:{&quot;attack&quot;:7}}}"><p><b>Clap and open hi-hat.</b> Claps on 2 and 4, open hats between the beats. Listen: a house beat.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-pat="{&quot;bpm&quot;:124,&quot;rows&quot;:{&quot;kick&quot;:&quot;x...x...x...x...&quot;,&quot;clap&quot;:&quot;....x.......x...&quot;,&quot;ohh&quot;:&quot;..x...x...x...x.&quot;,&quot;chh&quot;:&quot;.x.x.x.x.x.x.x.x&quot;},&quot;kit&quot;:{&quot;kick&quot;:{&quot;attack&quot;:7}}}"><p><b>Closed hats, no shuffle.</b> Shuffle at 1 (none). Listen: straight.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-pat="{&quot;bpm&quot;:124,&quot;shuffle&quot;:4,&quot;rows&quot;:{&quot;kick&quot;:&quot;x...x...x...x...&quot;,&quot;clap&quot;:&quot;....x.......x...&quot;,&quot;ohh&quot;:&quot;..x...x...x...x.&quot;,&quot;chh&quot;:&quot;.x.x.x.x.x.x.x.x&quot;},&quot;kit&quot;:{&quot;kick&quot;:{&quot;attack&quot;:7}}}"><p><b>Shuffle 4.</b> The off-beat 16ths move late. Listen: it swings.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-pat="{&quot;bpm&quot;:124,&quot;rows&quot;:{&quot;kick&quot;:&quot;X...x...X...x...&quot;,&quot;chh&quot;:&quot;.x.x.x.x.x.x.x.x&quot;},&quot;kit&quot;:{&quot;kick&quot;:{&quot;attack&quot;:7}}}"><p><b>Per-drum accent.</b> Accents on the bass drum only, on beats 1 and 3. Listen: those kicks are louder.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-pat="{&quot;bpm&quot;:128,&quot;rows&quot;:{&quot;kick&quot;:&quot;x...x...x...x...&quot;,&quot;chh&quot;:&quot;x.x.x.x.x.x.x.x.&quot;,&quot;snare&quot;:[0,0,0,0,{&quot;v&quot;:0.75,&quot;a&quot;:true},0,0,0,0,0,{&quot;v&quot;:0.75,&quot;f&quot;:4},{&quot;v&quot;:0.75},{&quot;v&quot;:0.75,&quot;a&quot;:true,&quot;f&quot;:6},{&quot;v&quot;:0.75,&quot;f&quot;:2},{&quot;v&quot;:0.75,&quot;a&quot;:true},{&quot;v&quot;:0.75,&quot;a&quot;:true}]}}"><p><b>Flams.</b> A snare fill where some hits are flams: two hits close together. Listen for the "fl-am".</p></div>
```

## Famous records

Named in Wikipedia, "Roland TR-909":

- Hiroshi Sato, *Sailing Blaster* (1984)
- Skinny Puppy, *Remission*
- Adamski, "Killer" (1990)

<div class="ik-q" data-a="0"><p><b>What does Shuffle do?</b></p><ul><li>Moves the off-beats late so it swings</li><li>Mixes up the order of drums</li><li>Makes it louder</li><li>Stops it</li></ul><p class="ik-why">Manual p. 26.</p></div>
<div class="ik-q" data-a="0"><p><b>A flam is…</b></p><ul><li>Two hits very close together</li><li>A very long hit</li><li>A kind of cymbal</li><li>A tempo</li></ul><p class="ik-why">Manual p. 26.</p></div>
